messages:
Vikram (AE): New POC request from Meridian — they want a tightly scoped 2-week trial for 3 micro-flows: intent routing, meeting-summary, and reply-tone normalization. Need baseline prompts, 120 gold examples/flow, quick eval harness, and a headline cost by EOD tomorrow. @Sophie @Ivy
Sophie (SE): Copy. Host first, Dedicated if legal insists on separate KMS/CP isolation. I'll draft a compact prompt inventory and include sample inputs.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Eval plan: 120 samples per flow (360 total) to balance speed/coverage. I can produce the harness and a run command: `./tools/eval --suite meridian_quick --n 120 --model redwood-hosted-v1 --out report.json`
Ivy (PM): Proposed success gates: intent accuracy >= 0.78, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.60, tone-accept >= 80% on blind review, p95 latency < 550ms, and <3% safety-block rate. Midpoint checkpoint end of week 1.
Sophie (SE): Prompt inventory (minimal, annotated):
1) intent_prompt_v1: "Pick one label from [billing, onboarding, bug, feature, other]. Return exact label"
2) summary_prompt_v1: "Produce 3 bullets: action items first, then outcome. Keep bullets concise."
3) tone_prompt_v1: "Rewrite the agent reply to be professional and empathetic, max 130 chars."
4) safety_check_v1: "If input violates policy, return 'REFUSE' and a one-line reason. Else tag 'OK'"
Sophie (SE): Each prompt will ship with 120 golden examples and an expected metric tag (accuracy/ROUGE/manual_agreement). I'll instrument per-response token_count and latency_ms.
Vikram (AE): Customer usage guess: avg 2 r/s, peak 9 r/s, ~320 tokens/req. Use that for initial cost sketch; finance will refine.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Security Qs: they requested data deletion SLAs and key-management details. Short answer: hosted POC defaults to 30-day logs retention, keys managed by Redwood; we can propose Dedicated for customer-managed KMS. I'll draft the answers.
reliability-bot: perftest: meridian-eval-canary build 1.4.2 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
Ivy (PM): Action items: 1) SE (Sophie) to upload prompts + gold sets by tomorrow AM. 2) Solutions Eng (Alex) to deliver eval harness + run instructions. 3) AE (Vikram) to collect any customer sample conversations. 4) Finance to return headline hosted vs dedicated delta.
Sophie (SE): Will keep prompt set minimal and add a confidence field to responses for triage. Will post link when uploaded.
Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll include a sample eval report and a small README showing how to interpret metrics. Example parsing: `jq '.results | map({flow: .flow, metric: .score})' report.json`
Vikram (AE): If we can get baseline artifacts tomorrow morning I can present scope + cost to Meridian on Thurs. Thanks team. :pray:
Ivy (PM): I'll draft the POC runbook and acceptance checklist and paste link here after upload.
Vikram (AE): Closing for now — ping here for blockers.
